API Reference

Welcome to the RoselineMCP API Reference. This section contains detailed documentation for all public APIs, interfaces, and classes.

Namespaces

RoselineMCP.Interfaces

Contains all service interfaces that define the contracts for the application's core functionality.

RoselineMCP.Services

Implementation of core services including solution analysis, code fixing, and diagnostic filtering.

RoselineMCP.Tools

MCP tool implementations that expose functionality through the Model Context Protocol.

RoselineMCP.Models

Data transfer objects and model classes used throughout the application.

Key Interfaces

Core Services

  • ISolutionAnalyzerService - Analyzes C# solutions and projects for diagnostics
  • ICodeFixService - Applies automated code fixes to projects
  • IDiagnosticFilterService - Filters and categorizes diagnostics
  • IPatchService - Generates unified diff patches

Supporting Services

  • IMSBuildService - Manages MSBuild workspace creation
  • ICodeFixProviderFactory - Creates and manages code fix providers
  • IDiffService - Performs text differencing operations

MCP Tools

The following tools are exposed through the Model Context Protocol:

AnalyzeSolution

Analyzes entire C# solutions for diagnostics with filtering options.

ListDiagnostics

Gets detailed diagnostics for specific projects with statistics.

ApplyFixes

Applies automated code fixes for specified diagnostic IDs.

CreatePatch

Generates unified diff patches between text versions.

Common Patterns

Service Registration

All services are registered as singletons in the dependency injection container:

services.AddSingleton<ISolutionAnalyzerService, SolutionAnalyzerService>();

Tool Implementation

MCP tools follow a consistent pattern:

[McpServerTool]
[Description("Tool description")]
public static async Task<string> ToolMethod(
    IService service,
    [Description("Parameter")] string param)
{
    // Implementation
}

Error Handling

All tools return JSON with consistent error structure:

{
  "error": "Error message",
  "type": "ExceptionType"
}
